Class AuthService

java.lang.Object
com.example.rivarly.service.AuthService
@Service public class AuthService extends Object
Service responsible for handling authentication-related operations. Includes user registration, login, token management, and fetching user information.

  • Method Details

    • register

      public AuthResponse register(RegisterRequest registerRequest)
      Registers a new user in the system. Ensures the nickname is unique, assigns default privileges, and generates tokens.
      Parameters:
      registerRequest - contains registration details like name, email, and password
      Returns:
      AuthResponse object containing access and refresh tokens along with user details

    • login

      public AuthResponse login(LoginRequest loginRequest)
      Logs in a user by validating credentials and generating new JWT tokens. Supports both email and nickname for login.
      Parameters:
      loginRequest - contains login credentials
      Returns:
      AuthResponse object containing access and refresh tokens along with user details

    • createRefreshToken

      public RefreshToken createRefreshToken(Person person)
      Creates a new refresh token for the given user. Stores the token in the database with an expiry date.
      Parameters:
      person - the user for whom the token is generated
      Returns:
      the generated RefreshToken entity

    • getRefreshTokenString

      public String getRefreshTokenString(Long personId)
      Retrieves the refresh token string associated with a given user ID.
      Parameters:
      personId - the ID of the user
      Returns:
      the refresh token string

    • refreshAccessToken

      public String refreshAccessToken(String requestRefreshToken)
      Refreshes the access token using a valid refresh token. Ensures the refresh token is not expired before generating a new access token.
      Parameters:
      requestRefreshToken - the refresh token provided by the client
      Returns:
      a new access token string

    • getCurrentPerson

      public AuthResponse getCurrentPerson(String nickname)
